lesson: In deformation/incidence problems, tangent-map rank is consumer-relevant only after an integrability/smoothness check at the source point. Singular tangent cones can fake full rank. Global component coverage additionally needs proper/closed image and component binding.
reuse_scope: algebraic/analytic deformation sources where actual image coverage is the consumer
breakpoints: if actual image/dominance is proved directly, tangent integrability is unnecessary
if target is singular, target tangent dimension may itself be a misleading proxy
does not license componentwise splitting of signed rational cycles
